scope: All four backbones: 8 static checkpoints + 4 normal builds + up to 4 qualified incident episodes. Same shared visual agent in all settings; one-shot static and direct dynamic LLM remain separate future groups.
sameInputProtocol: existing RGB evidence + text tool/inventory metadata; not strict image-only or full symbolic TI
thinking: off when supported; verify Ark actual parameter semantics before running

assumptions.basis: Prior real requests average about 6.2k–10.3k input, max 11.45k. Ark tokenizer and long-case histories not yet measured. Output range is a planning assumption for optional-thinking-disabled JSON actions, not a measurement.

prerequisites: Exact routes: three Ark models and explicitly authorized Aliyun Qwen. No fallback.
Two image/schema interface checks per backbone.
Fresh image/GT feasibility check for every episode.
Same-case/backbone/profile successful normal build before incident.
catalogueObservation: Authenticated read-only GET /models succeeded; catalogue visibility does not establish account inference permissions
seedThrottleReason: Endpoint TPM rejection observed in interface checks. Waiting changes wall time, not prompts or task budgets.
